title: Error Handling
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:48 AM

Error Handling
Typical errors that may occur with this operation are:

e No business partner ID is specified in the query

e The business partner ID specified in the query is invalid

Message Types

e ContractAccountAccountBalanceByCustomerQuery

e ContractAccountAccountBalanceByCustomerResponse

Prerequisites

The user has to have the required authorization to access the account balances for the specified contract accounts.

Notes on SAP Implementation

Prerequisites
You are using software component FI-CA (as of version FI-CA 6.02).

You have maintained the backend configuration of SAP Biller Direct in FI-CA (See Customizing for Contract Accounts Receivable
and Payable under Integration -> Financial Supply Chain Management -> Biller Direct -> Basic Setting for Customer Portal in

Internet ). Note that since this operation is based on the functions of SAP Biller Direct , its use is subject to the same license
conditions.

The user has sufficient authorizations, in particular with regard to authorization object F_KK_EBPP.
Processing

If an external business partner ID is specified in the query, it has to be mapped to the corresponding internal business partner ID.

This mapping is carried out based on the definition of event 6600.

More Information

For information about corrections and frequently asked questions relating to this service, refer to SAP Note 1063631 (collective
note) .

Find Contract Account Receivables Payables Register Item by ID

Definition

To find the register items of a contract account based on various selection criteria.
